purpose: Negative controls proving the Step 2 safety validator, label-leakage check, graph invariants and split invariants can report a defect. A check that cannot fail provides no protection while producing a passing CI signal.

controls.description: an unmutated generated page must produce zero violations
injecting a password form must trip credential_collection_fields
injecting real brand names must trip real_brand_names_in_adversarial_templates
injecting a real payment endpoint must trip both the processor and public-domain rules
injecting a script element must trip the malware/exfiltration family
a domain outside the reserved TLDs must be rejected
a real international number must be rejected
the word 'authorized' in page bytes must be caught
the machine-readable entity ID must not be allowed into visible prose
controls.evidence: entity_id=E0001 now visible; clean page visible=False

controls.description: the unmutated graph must satisfy every invariant
dropping every 'pay' edge for E0001 must trip the totality invariant
controls.evidence: 2 violation(s): ['16 (e,d) pairs are not total over all 5 actions', 'E0001 official domain is not authorized on all actions']

controls.description: making every edge authorized must trip the action- and entity-relativity invariants
controls.evidence: 10 violation(s): ['no (e,d) pair is authorized for one action and not another; ', 'no shared domain carries both authorized and unauthorized la', 'fabricated control E9001 has an authorized edge']

controls.description: an evidence_type outside the frozen enum must be rejected
two labels for one (e,d,a) triple must be rejected
controls.evidence: ['duplicate (e,d,a) triples present; a triple must have exactly one label']

controls.description: the unmutated plan must satisfy every invariant
copying a test entity template into train must be caught
controls.evidence: 2 violation(s): ['entity_template: pools test and train_development share 1 template(s),', 'entity_template: train_development fraction 0.516667 != required 0.5']

controls.description: moving one template between splits must break the exact 50/20/30 assertion
controls.evidence: 2 violation(s): ['entity_template: train_development fraction 0.516667 != required 0.5', 'entity_template: validation fraction 0.183333 != required 0.2']

controls.description: training on a held-out entity category must be caught by the CATEGORY check, with pool sizes and ratios left intact so no other check can mask it
controls.evidence: 1 violation(s), 0 of them ratio-related: ["transfer holdout categories ['bookshop', 'salon'] also appear in train/validatio"]

controls.description: putting a strongest-region attack template into the core must be caught
controls.evidence: 1 violation(s): ['core attack template A1333 lies inside the adaptive-holdout region']
